tools.name: runBqlQuery
tools.title: Run Beancount Query (BQL)
tools.description: Execute a BQL (Beancount Query Language) query against the user's ledger and return results. BQL: SELECT cols [WHERE expr] [GROUP BY] [ORDER BY] [LIMIT n] | JOURNAL | BALANCES. Columns: date, year, month, flag, payee, narration, account, number, currency, cost, change, balance, position, tags, links, meta. An unaggregated query returns one row per posting, not per transaction, so LIMIT 5 can span 3 transactions; GROUP BY and DISTINCT return one row per group or value. LIMIT bounds the returned rows. Output past 1,000 lines or 100 KB is cut and ends with a truncation line; add LIMIT or a narrower WHERE to see the rest. The query travels in a POST body end to end, so long queries have no URL-length ceiling. Reference: https://beancount.github.io/docs/beancount_query_language/

ledger.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

tools.name: runBqlQueryStructured
tools.title: Run BQL with Typed Results
tools.description: Execute BQL and return the typed table (column names, types, and rows) or structured text result. Uses the same query contract as REST JSON and GraphQL queryShell. The query travels in a POST body end to end, so long queries have no URL-length ceiling.

ledger.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

rowCount.description: Result rows returned, after LIMIT. An unaggregated query returns one row per posting (not per transaction); GROUP BY and DISTINCT return one row per group or value.

truncated.description: True when the result hit the 1000-row ceiling and rows were dropped. Add a LIMIT or a narrower WHERE to see a complete result.

tools.name: getEntryContext
tools.title: Read Entry Source Context
tools.description: Read the source context around one entry, addressed by the entry_hash listLedgerEntries returns (as entryHash or entry_hash); updateEntrySource and deleteEntrySource take the same hash and this result's sha256sum. Same data as the entry-context resource. A result with `generated_from` is a copy a plugin or a pad generated from that source entry (amortize_over, forecast, padding): it shares the source's slice and sha256sum, so editing or deleting it would change the source and every other copy; address the `generated_from` entry instead. An entry with `not_booked: true` is a transaction the ledger could not book (for example a sale with no matching lot): it is listed so it can be opened and fixed, but no balance counts it.

entry_hash.description: Alias of entryHash, as list output spells it.

ledger.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

tools.name: listLedgerEntries
tools.title: List Journal Entries
tools.description: List journal entries, each with the entry_hash getEntryContext, updateEntrySource, and deleteEntrySource take. Narrows by account, filter, time, directiveTypes, and the transactionSubtypes, documentSubtypes, and customSubtypes filters (each narrows only its own directive family); pages with limit and offset; total counts every match. Same data as the journal resource.

filter.description: Fava advanced-filter expression. `#tag` and `^link` match exactly; bare or "quoted" words match narration/payee (transactions) or comment (notes); `field:value` looks up `account` (posting accounts included), `tag`, `link`, `payee`, `narration`, `date`, or entry metadata; `field>100` compares amounts and bare `>100` matches posting units; `any(...)`/`all(...)` scope a test to postings; `-` negates, `,` is OR, juxtaposition is AND, parentheses group. Quote values holding a colon, a space, or a leading digit — `account:"Assets:Bank:Checking"`, `date:"2026"` — there are no escape sequences.

time.description: Time expression, e.g. 2026-08. Pre-window `open` directives are preserved as context and counted in total.

directiveTypes.description: Directive types to include, e.g. ["Transaction"]; case does not matter.

transactionSubtypes.description: Transaction flag filter, e.g. ["cleared"]: narrows transactions only, other directive families pass through; case does not matter.

documentSubtypes.description: Document subtype filter: narrows documents only, other directive families pass through; case does not matter.

customSubtypes.description: Custom-directive subtype filter: narrows custom directives only, other directive families pass through; case does not matter.

ledger.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

is_empty.description: True when this result holds no entries (total 0).

tools.name: addLedgerEntries
tools.title: Add Structured Ledger Entries
tools.description: Append entries [{type,entry}]. Supports transaction, commodity, price, note, balance, open, close, pad, budget, document, event; custom, query, option, and plugin are excluded, add them as raw text. Budget interval uses lowercase daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly. One posting per transaction may omit its amount and is written elided. An unbalanced transaction is refused with UNBALANCED, and entries that would add bean-check errors (a second open for an open account, a balance against an unopened account), or a budget for an account the ledger lacks, with VALIDATION_FAILED naming each error, unless allowInvalid records them deliberately. ledger is required unless pinned. The commit message is composed from the entries; there is no message argument. dry_run previews without committing.

tools.name: deleteLedgerFiles
tools.title: Delete Ledger Files
tools.description: Delete files in one atomic commit; pass each file's sha from readLedgerFiles to refuse the delete if it changed since. Deleting a file still `include`d by another ledger file is refused as `BAD_USER_INPUT` naming the includers; remove the include from the including file(s) first, then delete. An include counts when its target resolves to the deleted path the way the ledger loads it, relative to the directory of the file that declares it, and glob includes never count. Each new/resulting file is limited to 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes, including dry runs. dry_run previews without committing: the same refusal as the commit, plus a unified diff per touched file and bean-check's verdict over the projected contents. A change that adds bean-check errors is refused with VALIDATION_FAILED (dry_run too); allow_invalid commits it anyway, e.g. one step of a multi-step edit.

tools.name: updateEntrySource
tools.title: Update Entry Source
tools.description: Replace one entry's source text with newContent, addressed by the entry_hash listLedgerEntries returns (as entryHash or entry_hash) and sha256sum from getEntryContext. The commit message is composed from the operation; there is no message argument. Returns the entry's new hash as newEntryHash; the request's hash is stale after the commit. A replacement that would take a free ledger past its directive limit is RESOURCE_LIMIT_REACHED. A write that would add a bean-check error the ledger did not have is refused with VALIDATION_FAILED naming each new error — lone imbalance refuses as UNBALANCED with the residual; pass allowInvalid: true to commit it anyway. dry_run previews without committing.

tools.name: createLedger
tools.title: Create Ledger
tools.description: Create a ledger owned by the authenticated user. Requires name; accepts description, private, template (STARTER default, including null: options and accounts without transactions; SAMPLE: demonstration transactions), a setup specification (mutually exclusive with template), and a requestId for idempotent retries. Refused for ledger-pinned credentials.

name.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, joined by single hyphens.

description.description: A short description shown with the ledger, up to 2048 characters.

private.description: true or omitted keeps the ledger visible only to its owner and collaborators; false makes it public, readable by anyone.

template.description: STARTER (the default) has options and accounts without transactions; SAMPLE has demonstration transactions.

tools.name: previewLedgerSetup

tools.description: Preview a ledger setup (ADR021) without creating anything: returns the files, account list, and validation result the specification would produce. Accepts the same setup object as createLedger.

tools.name: updateLedger

anyOf.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, joined by single hyphens.

description.description: A short description shown with the ledger, up to 2048 characters.

private.description: true makes the ledger visible only to its owner and collaborators; false makes it public, readable by anyone; omitted leaves it as it is.

resources.name: tempAssetDownloadUrl
resources.title: Temporary Asset Download URL
resources.description: Presign a download for an objectKey owned by the current user. Returns downloadUrl and expiresIn in seconds. Foreign, malformed, and permanent object keys are refused.

resources.name: publicUserProfile
resources.title: Public user profile
resources.description: Profile, activities, and repositories for username. Authenticated self-views retain existing private enrichment; other targets use the public view.

resources.name: userFollowers
resources.title: followers
resources.description: Public social discovery. page defaults to 1 and limit to 20; total is the page size. Upstream failure returns an empty page.

resources.name: userFollowing
resources.title: following
resources.description: Public social discovery. page defaults to 1 and limit to 20; total is the page size. Upstream failure returns an empty page.

resources.name: getFeed
resources.title: Your activity feed
resources.description: Read your merged blog, release, and ledger activity. Requires a session or account-wide OAuth credential with ledger.read.

resources.name: userProfile
resources.title: Your profile
resources.description: Read your account profile and limits. An explicit userId must be your own user ID.

resources.name: health
resources.title: Application health
resources.description: Public application health probe; not a dependency readiness check.

resources.name: featureFlags
resources.title: Feature flags
resources.description: Public static feature configuration. The legacy userId does not affect the result.

resources.name: ledgerArchive
resources.title: Ledger Archive
resources.description: Download archive bytes as an MCP base64 blob, up to 8 MiB. `archive` is a Git reference and its format, `<ref>.zip` or `<ref>.tar.gz` (for example `main.zip`), as on REST. A larger archive is refused; read `beancount://{owner}/{name}/archive-download-url` for an HTTP URL that streams it at any size. Every call rechecks ledger read authority and spends the shared archive-download budget.

resources.name: ledgerAssetDownloadUrl
resources.title: Ledger Asset Download URL
resources.description: Issue a presigned asset URL after resolving ledgerRepoId and checking current file-read authority. filename is relative to the repository's asset directory. The service enforces any credential ledger pin.

resources.name: ledgerArchiveDownloadUrl
resources.title: Ledger Archive Download URL
resources.description: Get the authenticated HTTP URL for main.zip. It is a REST endpoint: fetch it with a personal API key (x-api-key) or a signed-in browser session; an MCP OAuth token is scoped to the MCP endpoint and is refused there. No credential is embedded in the URL. This resource discovers a URL and does not deliver archive bytes.

resources.name: ledgerCollaboratorPermission

resources.description: Read the journal with pagination and all subtype filters. Subtype filters are JSON-encoded string arrays. Each narrows only its own directive family and passes other families through — combine with directiveTypes to restrict the families returned.

resources.name: ledgerBalanceSheet
resources.title: Balance Sheet
resources.description: Balance sheet with report-only current earnings in equity and its interval series under the configured account names. Accepts account, filter, time, conversion, interval, and shape; returns the same structured data as REST.

resources.name: ledgerAccounts
resources.title: Ledger Accounts
resources.description: Account names, optionally restricted to open or closed accounts.

resources.name: ledgerOptions
resources.title: Get the ledger's core options
resources.description: The effective Beancount options: title, the five account-root names, the current conversions and earnings accounts, comma rendering, and the operating currencies. Values are what the ledger resolves, defaults included, so a client need not parse option lines. `operatingCurrency` is what the ledger reports in; the currencies its postings use are a separate vocabulary read.

resources.name: accessibleLedgers
resources.title: List the caller's accessible ledgers, restricted to the credential's ledger pin when present
resources.description: List the caller's accessible ledgers, restricted to the credential's ledger pin when present

resources.name: ledgerMetadata
resources.title: Ledger Metadata
resources.description: Read ledger metadata, visibility, repository URLs, caller permissions, and whether the caller has starred it (isStarred).

resources.name: ledgerPayees
resources.title: List payees used in the ledger
resources.description: Every payee that appears on a transaction. The list a client should reconcile against before inventing a new payee string.

resources.name: ledgerNarrations
resources.title: List narrations used in the ledger
resources.description: Every narration string that appears on a transaction.

resources.name: ledgerCurrencies
resources.title: List currencies used in the ledger
resources.description: Every currency the ledger's postings are denominated in. Writing an entry in a currency absent from this list is usually a typo.

resources.name: ledgerTags
resources.title: List tags used in the ledger
resources.description: Every `#tag` that appears on a directive.

resources.name: ledgerLinks
resources.title: List links used in the ledger
resources.description: Every `^link` that appears on a directive.

resources.name: ledgerYears
resources.title: List years the ledger covers
resources.description: Every year that has at least one directive — the ledger's span, without reading it.

resources.name: ledgerCommodities
resources.title: List commodities and their price pairs
resources.description: Commodity pairs held in the ledger, with the prices recorded for them.

resources.name: ledgerManagedPrices
resources.title: List managed price sources and their freshness
resources.description: One record per managed price include (`include "https://beancount.io/prices/BTC-USD"`): the feed's commodity pair and source, the revision serving, when it was observed and fetched, when it next refreshes, and `freshness` — `recent` within ten minutes of the latest observation, `stale` beyond it, `unavailable` when no revision has validated (then `error` says why). Check it before trusting a valuation built on a managed feed. Empty when the ledger has no managed include.

resources.name: ledgerEvents
resources.title: List event directives
resources.description: Event directives in date order, with optional account, time, and Fava-expression filters.

resources.name: ledgerErrors
resources.title: List the ledger's parse and validation errors
resources.description: What `bean-check` reports for this ledger. An empty list means the ledger is currently valid. The engine's warnings (a one-posting entry, closing an account with a balance) are not listed: `bean-check` does not fail on them.

resources.name: ledgerAttributes
resources.title: Get the ledger's attributes
resources.description: Accounts, currencies, payees, and links as one document — the summary the other endpoints break out individually.

resources.name: ledgerOverview
resources.title: Get the ledger overview
resources.description: Net worth now and over time. `shape=summary` (the default) returns the net-worth series in one currency; `shape=fava` returns the account hierarchies and income/expense series the dashboard charts.

resources.name: ledgerDocuments
resources.title: List ledger documents
resources.description: Document directives with account, time, and Fava-expression filters.

resources.name: ledgerTrialBalance
resources.title: Get the trial balance
resources.description: Every account's debit and credit totals — the statement that proves the books balance.

resources.name: ledgerHoldings
resources.title: Get holdings
resources.description: Lots grouped by account or commodity — units, average cost, cost basis, market value — valued at today's quotes. `conversion` takes a currency or `units` (default: the operating currency when the ledger declares exactly one, else each group's held currency); `account` names a parent account or a regular expression. Costless cash and fully-sold groups are left out; groups without a quote value at cost and are named in `missing_prices`.

resources.name: ledgerRegister
resources.title: Get one account's register
resources.description: One account's dated entries with a running balance, oldest first — each entry with the subtree postings behind it. `account` names a parent account or a regular expression resolving to one subtree; `conversion` takes a currency or `units` (default: the operating currency when the ledger declares exactly one, else each row's held currencies). A time window carries the opening balance forward.

resources.name: ledgerCapitalGains
resources.title: Get realized capital gains
resources.description: One row per closed lot — quantity, proceeds, basis, gain — plus one-year bucket totals. A lot closes when a reducing posting carries booked cost and price; splits and own-account transfers carry no price and are left out. `fromDate`/`toDate` bound the sale date, `account` filters the posting account, and `time` scopes the window; all figures stay in their booked currencies.

resources.name: ledgerIntervalTotals
resources.title: Get totals per interval
resources.description: Balances grouped by period — the series behind a spending-over-time view, without the view. `shape=summary` (the default) states one currency and drops zero accounts; `shape=fava` returns the raw per-currency balances.

resources.name: ledgerAccountReport
resources.title: Get one account's report
resources.description: Balances and changes for a single account over the selected period.

resources.name: ledgerAccountLastEntries
resources.title: List the latest entry per account
resources.description: The most recent directive touching each account — how stale each part of the ledger is.

resources.name: ledgerEntriesCount
resources.title: Count entries per directive type
resources.description: How many transactions, opens, balances, and so on the ledger holds.

resources.name: ledgerPostingsPerAccount
resources.title: Count postings per account
resources.description: Posting counts for the filtered Statistics report stream. An account filter selects matching entries and counts every posting on those entries, including counterpart accounts. Time filters use the same clamped report stream as entries-count.

resources.name: ledgerPayeeTransactions
resources.title: Get a payee's most recent transaction
resources.description: The single most recent transaction recorded against this payee, or null if there is none. This is Fava's autocomplete lookup — a template for the next entry, not a history. For every transaction by a payee, query the journal or BQL instead.

resources.name: ledgerNarrationTransactions
resources.title: Get a narration's most recent transaction
resources.description: The single most recent transaction recorded against this narration string, or null if there is none. Fava's autocomplete lookup, like payee-transactions. An explicit empty narration is valid. In MCP, read `beancount://{owner}/{name}/narration-transactions?narration=` for empty text. Nonempty values also support the existing path alias `beancount://{owner}/{name}/narration-transactions/{narration}`; percent-encode the value once.

resources.name: ledgerPayeeAccounts
resources.title: Rank every account by this payee's history
resources.description: Every account in the ledger, re-sorted by how recently and often this payee was booked against it (exponential decay). Accounts the payee never touched are still present, at the back — the leading entries are the suggestion, not the whole list. Reach for the first few when categorising a new transaction for this payee.

resources.name: ledgerEntryContext
resources.title: Get the source context around one entry
resources.description: The ledger text surrounding a directive, addressed by its hash — what to read before editing it. A result with `generated_from` is a copy a plugin or a pad generated from that source entry: it shares the source's slice and sha256sum, so editing or deleting it would change the source and every other copy. An entry with `not_booked: true` is a transaction the ledger could not book (for example a sale with no matching lot): it is listed so it can be opened and fixed, but no balance counts it.

resources.name: ledgerAccountDirectives
resources.title: List open/close directives per account
resources.description: Each account's open and close directives — which accounts are usable on a given date. `entryCount` counts the account's postings, not its directives.

resources.name: bankList
resources.title: Linked Banks
resources.description: Every bank connection linked to this ledger.

resources.name: bank
resources.title: One Linked Bank
resources.description: Status and institution details for a single bank connection.

resources.name: bankAccountsForItem
resources.title: A Bank's Accounts
resources.description: The accounts one bank connection shares.

resources.name: bankAccounts
resources.title: All Bank Accounts
resources.description: Accounts across every linked bank, with their institution and ledger-account mapping.

resources.name: bankUnsyncedTransactions
resources.title: Transactions Not Yet In The Ledger
resources.description: Transactions pulled from a bank that have not been written into the ledger — what `importStagedBankTransactions` writes.

resources.name: bankSuggestedCategories
resources.title: Suggested Categories For Unsynced Transactions
resources.description: A ledger account suggested for each staged transaction, drawn from the ledger's own history. Requires ledger-content read, bank-connection read, and AI-use authority.

resources.name: bankSuggestedMapping
resources.title: Suggested Ledger Account Per Bank Account
resources.description: Which ledger account each of a bank's accounts most likely corresponds to. Requires ledger-content read, bank-connection read, and AI-use authority.

resources.name: ledgerFile
resources.title: Ledger File Contents
resources.description: The text of one file in the ledger repository, addressed by its path. Reading it needs no tool call, so an agent can pull a file into context without spending a tool slot.

resources.name: unknownResource
resources.title: Unknown Resource
resources.description: Not a resource. Any `beancount://` URI matching no template above reads as NOT_FOUND with the grammar to use; `resources/templates/list` is the inventory.

prompts.name: close-month
prompts.title: Close The Month
prompts.description: Month-end close ritual: reconcile active accounts, verify balance assertions, check recurring-entry completeness, sweep flagged entries, and report the period's P&L. Reports what it cannot verify instead of forcing a tie-out.

arguments.name: month
arguments.description: Period to close as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the last complete calendar month.

arguments.name: ledger
arguments.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

prompts.name: reconcile-account
prompts.title: Reconcile An Account Against A Statement
prompts.description: Diff one account against one statement period, classify every discrepancy, and — after confirmation — append the missing transactions plus a period-end balance assertion that proves the account ties out.

arguments.name: account
arguments.description: The single account to reconcile, e.g. Assets:Bank:Checking.

arguments.name: statement
arguments.description: The statement itself: CSV text or pasted PDF text. Omit it to be asked for it.

arguments.name: ledger
arguments.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

prompts.name: categorize-imports
prompts.title: Categorize Staged Bank Transactions
prompts.description: Sync a linked bank, deduplicate the staged transactions against what the ledger already holds, propose a counter-account for each from the ledger's own history, and write the confirmed ones.

arguments.name: item_id
arguments.description: The linked bank's id. Omit it to work with whatever is already staged.

arguments.name: ledger
arguments.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

prompts.name: spending-report
prompts.title: Report On Spending
prompts.description: Answer analytical questions about the ledger with shown, re-runnable BQL — spending, trends, net worth, burn rate, subscriptions. Strictly read-only; every figure comes from a query the user can see.

arguments.name: period
arguments.description: The period to report on, e.g. 2026-06 or last quarter.

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: A specific question to start from, e.g. how much did I spend on groceries.

arguments.name: ledger
arguments.description: Target ledger as owner/name. Required for an unpinned credential; defaults to the credential's ledger restriction.

localizations.name: Beancount.io
localizations.description: Connect to hosted Beancount ledgers over Streamable HTTP with OAuth for BQL, reports, files, bank imports, and validated accounting edits.
